intro: Convert centimeters to inches accurately for personal height, furniture dimensions, and packaging specs. Under the 1959 international definition, 1 inch equals exactly 2.54 centimeters, so dividing any cm value by 2.54 gives exact decimal inches (1 cm ≈ 0.39370079 in). Enter whole numbers or decimals like 13.5 cm or 77.5 cm above to see both decimal inches and nearest 1/16 and 1/64 tape fractions, or browse our reference chart below.
alsoWrittenAs: centimetres to inches, cm to in, centimeter to inch, cm into inches
tableSubtitle: Complete cm-to-inch reference chart covering clothing measurements, furniture dimensions, and body heights, with nearest 1/64" and 1/16" tape fractions.
tableRoundingNote: Computed with the exact factor 1 cm = 1 / 2.54 in (≈ 0.39370079 in); decimal inches rounded to up to 5 decimal places alongside nearest 1/64" and 1/16" fractions.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact 2.54 Divisor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: Always divide centimeters by the exact 2.54 definition rather than multiplying by a truncated 0.39 factor, which creates ~0.94% error (over 1.6 inches off on 176 cm).
For height measurements, divide the total inch result by 12 to express it in feet and inches (for example, 69.29 in = 5 ft 9.29 in).

faqs.question: How many inches (in) are in 1 centimeter (cm)?
faqs.answer: There are approximately 0.39370079 inches (in) in 1 centimeter (cm), computed as 1 ÷ 2.54. Conversely, 1 international inch equals exactly 2.54 centimeters.

faqs.question: How do I convert centimeters to inches (cm to in)?
faqs.answer: To convert centimeters to inches, divide the centimeter value by 2.54 (in = cm ÷ 2.54). For example, 45 cm ÷ 2.54 equals 17.71654 inches.

faqs.question: What is 176 cm in inches?
faqs.answer: 176 centimeters (cm) equals 69.29134 inches (in), which is approximately 5 feet 9.3 inches.
